metadata.notes: Example registry for responsibility spheres and boundary contexts. Organizations should customize this to reflect their own governance structure.

boundary_contexts.description: Messaging platform boundary (SMS, instant messaging, chat)

intra_system_boundary_types.description: Escape from an application sandbox or restricted execution environment to the host OS or a less-restricted context.
intra_system_boundary_types.notes: Examples: browser sandbox escape, container breakout, app sandbox bypass.

intra_system_boundary_types.description: Elevation from a lower privilege level to a higher one within the same system.
intra_system_boundary_types.notes: Examples: user-to-root, low-integrity to high-integrity, unprivileged to kernel.

intra_system_boundary_types.description: Crossing from one process's address space or security context into another on the same host.
intra_system_boundary_types.notes: Examples: process injection, DLL hijacking, shared memory manipulation.

intra_system_boundary_types.description: Escape from a virtual machine to the hypervisor or to another VM on the same host.
intra_system_boundary_types.notes: Examples: VM escape, hyperjacking, side-channel across VM boundary.
